tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i bsnyen thabs sbyin sreg dang bcas pa gzhan phan bdud rtsi'i 'od can zhes bya ba bzhugs so// bla ma dang rje btsun seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la 'dir slob dpon tsaṇ+ḍa go mi nas brgyud de/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la bka' babs pa'i 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i bsnyen pa bya tshul ni/ dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams kyis mdzad pa'i gdon grol gyi cho ga'i yi ge phun tshogs bsam 'phel las/ 'di'i rjes gnang dang lung thob pa'i gang zag gis/ bum pa la brten pa'i bsnyen pa ni gong ma'i gsung rab sogs las shes par bya'o/ /'dir bdag gi rnal 'byor la brten nas rab mtshan ma'i bsnyen pa dngos sam rmi lam du sku mthong ba sogs rtags ma byung gi bar dang / 'bring dus kyi bsnyen pa zla ba drug tha ma grangs kyi bsnyen pa 'bum phrag brgyad dam gzhi gtsang sbra dang ldan pas bya'o/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar las/ dang po bum pa la brten pa ni/ chos rje khu dbon gyi gsung la rin chen rgyal mtshan gyis zin bris mdzad pa'i gdon grol gyi yi ge las/ bdag bskyed gyi bzlas pa nyung ngur byas nas bum par seng ge sgra yan lag bzhi rdzogs mchod bstod dang bcas pa bgyis te/ gzungs thag bzung nas snying po bzhi 'bum sogs ma song gi bar du thun bcad kyis sgrub par bshad pas de ltar ram/ shin tu khyer bde ba ni bdag bskyed la brten pa 'di yin pas/ de'i tshul la sbyor dngos rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ ri khrod la sogs pa gnas dben zhing gtsang la byin rlabs che ba/ mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa'i sa phyogs su 'di'i bris sku yod na dgram pa'i drung stegs gtsang ma khebs ldan 'bru bcas la dmar skyur gyi dri ma med cing dkar gsum mngar gsum dang phye chu gtsang ma las sbrus pa'i zlum gtor rgyan ldan/

chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pa gso chas dang bcas pa dang / de la kha phyogs par rang gi stan spyi chags ma yin pa'i drung stegs la rdor dril lam ting shags gang rung bcas bshams te/ rang nyid kyang sha chang sgog btsong sogs/ mi gtsang ba'i rigs spangs te khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas zla ba gang rung gi tshes brgyad nya stong gi dgong thun la zhugs pa nas bzung thun bzhi'am gsum gyi sbyor bas zla ba gcig gam drug gi ring mtshams bya ba ste/ de bar la mtshams g.yog gcig gnyis zhig dang / lha rje dang / phyogs kyi yi ge mi 'jug ka med rnams dmigs 'og tu chug par byas la gzhan 'grim 'grul bsrung ba'i mtshams tho 'dzugs pa sogs ni spyi ltar ro/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni gong du bshad pa'i stan la 'dug la/ thog mar mchod rdzas rnams/ oṃ a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ 'og tu bsang sbyang zhes pa'i skabs su 'di ltar dran par bya'o/ /stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ zhes dang / so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dhu pe swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi te swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra pra tsā li ni/ pra dzñā pa ra mi ta nā da saṃ bha we na/ badz+ra dharma hri da ya/ san+to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho a khaṃ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/

dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs༞ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la༞ zhes pa lan nyer gcig la sogs pa ci nus byas la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rje btsun seng ge sgra'i bsgom bzlas nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /zhes pa lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ rang skad cig gis 'phags pa seng ge sgrar gsal ba'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'phags pa seng ge sgra la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas pas spyan drangs/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na mo ā hrīḥsing ha nā da sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes pas phyag bya/ oṃ āḥhrīḥsing ha nā da sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gan+dhaṃ/ nai wi d+yaṃ/ shap+ta pra tīts+tsha ye swāhā/ zhes pas mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rje yi rang / /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis bzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi/ /rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi/ /byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gi mgron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi/ /'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /sogs lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags dang /

sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig sogs kyis tshad med bzhi bsgoms la/ oṃ shu n+yā ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma ko3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar piṃ las seng ge dkar po mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad bcom/ 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥyig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid 'phags pa seng ge sgra sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon pad+ma dkar po'i yu ba bzung nas dku g.yon gyi phyogs su gdan la brten cing snyan gyi thad sor kha bye ba'i steng na ral gri me 'bar ba dang / thod pa dkar po me tog dang 'bru bcud sman rtsi sna tshogs kyis gang ba 'dzin pa/ zhal 'dzum bag dang ldan zhing ral pa'i thor cog spyi bor bcings pa/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing / dbu'i gtsug tor dang bcas pa sku g.yas phyogs su cung zad ma reg pa'i tri shu la ljang khu'i yu bar sbrul dkar sngo gnyis mgo bo gyen du bstan nas dkris pa/ kriṣ+ṇa sa ra'i pags pas nu ma g.yon bkab cing / dar dmar po'i sham thabs can/ tshangs skud ma gtogs pa'i rgyan gzhan thams cad spangs pa dka' thub kyi cha lugs can/ zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa seng ge sgra la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ

oṃ āḥhrīḥsing ha na da sa pa ri wā ra oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ rang la gnyis su med par thim/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pā ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs gong bzhin mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med pas dbur brgyan/ rang gi spyi bo nas rnam par snang mdzad/ dpung pa g.yas nas mi bskyod pa/ g.yon nas 'od dpag med/ sku sta zur g.yas nas rin chen 'byung ldan/ g.yon nas don yod grub pa rnams 'phros nas gnas de dang de nyid du bzhugs par gyur/ gnyis pa ni/ rang nyid lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa'i thugs ka'i hrīḥyig gi mtha' mar sngags 'phreng kha dog dkar pos bskor ba las 'od 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyangs/ khyad par klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad zhi bar byin gyis brlab par gyur/ zhes brjod cing bsam la ngag tu/ oṃ āḥhrīḥsing ha nā da hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brgya stong khri la sogs pa ci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar/ thun zhabs su gzungs ring 'di yang bzla ste/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ na mo ār+ya a ba lo ki te shwa ra ya/ bo dhi satwa ya/ ma hā satwa ya/ ma hā ka ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a ka ṭe/ bi ka ṭe/ ni ka ṭe/ ka ṭaṃ ka ṭe/ ka ro ṭe/ ka ro ṭa/ bir+ya ye swāhā/ zhes pa ji ltar rigs pa bzlas pa'i mthar bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun du byon par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhrīḥsing ha nā da sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ rdo rje dril bu'am ting shags 'dzin pas/

brtse ba'i thugs rje dbang phyug nyid kyi sku/ /drang srong chen po'i tshul du bstan nas kyang / /'gro ba'i sdug bsngal drag po sel mdzad pa'i/ /bcom ldan seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi gnas skabs kyi 'gal rkyen klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa/ nad gdon sdug bsngal thams cad zhi ba dang / mthar thug seng ge sgra'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ thun mtshams kyi gtor ma ni bris sku yod pa'am/ med kyang rung ste/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dmar po zhes pa nas/ dbur brgyan zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin la/ rang nyid ces pa dor/ gtor ma chu gtsang mas sbyangs la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang / oṃ āḥhrīḥsing hā nā da sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmā nam ad+ya nut+man+na twata/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa gsum mam lngas phul la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sing hā nā da sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyan ras kyis/ /sems can kun la gzigs mdzad pa/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes pas bstod la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi gnas skabs kyi 'gal rkyen klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa/ nad gdon sdug bsngal thams cad zhi ba dang / mthar thug seng ge sgra'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab bo/ /gsum pa rjes ni/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/

badz+ra satwa twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha/ ḍi ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shri yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wan sarba ta thā ga ta/ badz+ra mā me muñtsa/ badz+ri bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ zhes yi ge brgya pa tshar gsum dang / ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par gsol/ /sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ bris sku yod na/ 'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /sogs kyis brtan bzhugs dang / med na/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥ thal mo rgyab sbyar ba'i mtheb srin gyis se gol dang bcas gshegs su gsol la/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim/ rang gi dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs khar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis byin gyis brlabs shing / dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /'jig rten dbang phyug 'grub gyur nas/ /'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa/ /de yi sa la 'god par shog /ces pa tsam gyis dge ba bsngo ba'o/ /spro na/ sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig sogs/ sems can 'di dag sogs/ dge ba 'di yis skye bo kun/ /sogs/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs/ sangs rgyas sku gsum sogs kyis dge ba bsngos la/ che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med/ /chos rje nyi ma rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis/ /bdud dang bgegs rigs gnod pa'i dgra zhi ste/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /chos nyid bden pa'i chos mchog bla na med/ /dam chos bdud rtsi bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/

/nyon mongs sdug bsngal gdung ba'i dgra zhi ste/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /dge 'dun yon tan rin chen dpal 'bar ba/ /rgyal sras phan mdzad bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /nyes pa'i skyon bral dge tshogs rnam par 'phel/ /rtag tu dpal gnas nyin mtshan bkra shis shog /tshangs dang lha dbang srung ma'i byin rlabs dang / /phan mdzad lha yi bkra shis gnas gyur te/ /dge legs bsam pa yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /tshe ring nad med bde skyid ldan par shog /nyin mo bde legs sogs kyis bkra shis bya'o/ /de lta bu'i tshul gyis zla ba drug byed na 'bum phrag brgyad cu dang / zla ba gcig byed na 'bum phrag brgyad dam dgu kha skong dang bcas pa'am/ yang na bzhi 'bum kha skong dang bcas pa bya zhing / spro zhing grub na gzungs 'bum phrag bzhi kha skong dang bcas pa bzla ba ni bsnyen pa'o/ /de ltar bsnyen pa legs par them pa'i gang zag gi sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba'i phyir sbyin sreg bya ba ni/ sa phyogs de nyid dam gzhan du'ang rung ste/ thab khung zlum po khru gang pa'i nang du kha khyer dang mu ran sor bzhi bzhis bskor/ mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng ba 'bri/ phyi rol du stegs bu gru bzhi pa/ zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bya/ gzhi tshon thams cad dkar po/ rdo rje ser po de'i nang du pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad kyi lte bar seng ge sgra'i tshon spungs dkar po/ rigs lnga'i mtshan ma gtso bo'i steng ste mdun nam rgyab tu dkar po/ shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang khu rnams tshon spungs sam/ yang na me tog gi tshom bu sogs gang rung bkod/ kha khyer gyi steng du bud shing brtsigs/ shar lho'i mtshams su me tshang bya/ thab kyi nub tu sgrub pa po'i stan dang / mdun du bsang chu/ 'thor g.yab/ rdo rje dril bu/ dgang gzar blugs gzar/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad rnams sta gon bya/ sgrub pa po'i g.yas nas/

yam shing mar til zas mchog dang / /'bras dang so ba nas sran ma/ /gro dang dur ba ku sha ste/ /g.yon du 'das pa'i gtor ma dang / /mdun du chu gnyis nyer mchod lnga/ /de yi phyi ru cha gsum dang / /me lha'i gtor ma rim bzhin bshams/ /de nas phyi dro'i dus su khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du 'gro bas/ 'byor na gos rgyan dkar pos brgyan la zhi ba'i sems dang ldan pas mchod pa byin rlabs nas bzung / mthar thug seng ge sgra'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis rlabs tu gsol zhes pa'i bar gong gi bdag bskyed bzhin la/ snying po phreng 'khor dang / gzungs gsum sogs ci 'grub bzla ba'o/ /bsang chur dmigs/ oṃ a mṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas pas byin gyis brlabs la/ rdzas rnams la gtor te/ 'khyil pas bsangs/ swā bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las zhes pa nas/ thogs pa med pa zhes pa'i bar gong gi mchod pa byin rlabs bzhin la/ nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa dang / bsreg rdzas rnams lha mnyes par byed pa'i nus pa dang ldan par bskyed/ mchod rdzas bsreg rdzas so so'i sngags gsham nas 'byung ba bzhin dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs/ rtswa gtsang ma dang bcas pas yam shing gi rtse la me sbar te snying po brjod cing thab la g.yas nas lan gsum bskor te/ oṃ ag+ne ye dz+wa la raṃ zhes dang / me tshang du gzhug rtswa skam po gzhan dang bcas pas me sbar la/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba/ nang ye shes kyi me rab tu 'bar bas gang bar bskyed la/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas/ shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang / rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ oṃ tshur byon tshur byon 'byung po che/ /lha yi drang srong gnyis skyes mchog

/sreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du/ /'dir ni yang dag bsten par mdzod/ /oṃ ag+na ye ma hā te dzaḥsarba karma pra sa da ka ka ru ṇ+ya kṛta sarba ar+tha a smin san+ni hi to bha wa zhes pas spyan drangs/ pad+ma ka ma lā ya satwaṃ gyis gdan phul la/ thab kyi dbus su pad+ma dang ra skyes kyi gdan la 'khod pa ni/ me lha sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas bgrang phreng dang g.yon ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun babs pa/ drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ zhes brjod/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa/ thab dang yo byad kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bskyed la/ oṃ ku sha 'di ni gtsang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de/ /tshangs pa yi yang dag byed yin/ /des bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig swāhā zhes dang / oṃ badz+ra satwa a/ zhes pas thab kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du rtse mo g.yas bskor du dbul/ me lha'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la raṃ/ dgang blugs kyi gzar bu'i kha la'ang raṃ gyis mtshan par gyur/ zhes dang / oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ zhes pa lan bdun gyi mthar/ dgang blugs kha sbyar la/ oṃ ag+na ye/ ā dī bya/ ā dī bya/ ā bi ṣa/ ā bi ṣa/ ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya ba ha nā ya swāhā/ zhes brjod/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan dbul/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa re re'i 'gor sbyar ba'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur zhing / /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad bsreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pas bstod/

sreg rdzas rnams lag pa g.yon pas bzung la/ g.yas pas steng nas blang zhing mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul te/ de yang / oṃ bo dhi brik+ṣa ye swāhā/ gnyis sam drug gam nyi shu'i bar brjod la/ oṃ bo dhi brik+ṣa ye/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las nyon sdig sgrib nad gdon sdug bsngal thams cad gsang sngags lhag chad kyi nyes pa thams cad shin+taṃ ku ru swāhā/ zhes yam shing gsum mam bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig sogs phul/ de bzhin du 'og ma thams cad la shes par byas la/ oṃ ag+na ye swāhā/ mar/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da hā na badz+ra ye swāhā/ til/ oṃ sarba saṃ pa de swāhā/ zas mchog oṃ badz+ra puṣ+ṭa ye swāhā/ 'bras/ oṃ badz+ra bi dzā ye swāhā/ so ba/ oṃ badz+ra be gā ya swāhā/ nas/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā ba lā ya swā hā/ sran ma/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rā ya swā hā/ gro/ oṃ badz+ra a yu ṣe swāhā/ dur ba/ oṃ a pra ti ha ta badz+ra ya swāhā/ ku sha rnams phul la/ gong ltar mchod bstod byas la/ mar blugs gzar gang thab du blugs te/ oṃ ag+na ye dza la raṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam/ slar yang me bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las me 'bar ba'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad kyi lte bar/ piṃ las seng ge dkar po mgo bo g.yas su bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su hrīḥdakar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi nad gdon sdig sgrib klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa thams cad bcom/ 'phags pa seng ge sgra'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus hrīḥyig la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las 'phags pa seng ge sgra sku mdog dkar po zhes sogs nas bzung zhabs gnyis rgyal po rol pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ de'i steng du oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/

'dab ma brgyad kyi shar du hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya can/ lhor traṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas mchog sbyin/ g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ nub tu hrīḥlas 'od dpag tu med pa sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ byang du a las don yod grub pa sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas skyabs sbyin/ g.yon ting nge 'dzin gyi phyag rgya can/ thams cad kyang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing dar gyi na bza' can sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa'o/ /de thams cad kyi dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par ā/ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ rje btsun seng ge sgra rigs lnga'i tshogs pa can la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spos dang bcas pas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing / /bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i/ /bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru/ /'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnams sbyangs shing / /smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa'i/ /khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na/ /de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas/ /rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing / /mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir/ /yang dag 'khor dang bcas rnams gshegs su gsol/ /chos rnams kun gyi dbang phyug gtso/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog 'dra zhing / /nyi ma las lhag gzi brjid che/ /dad pas spyan ni drang bar bgyi/ /zhi zhing thugs rje che ldan pa/ /dul zhing bsam gtan sa la gzhug

/chos dang ye shes chags bral ba/ /kun tu mi bzad nus par ldan/ /tshur spyon tshur spyon zhi bdag lha/ /thub pa'i skyes mchog thams cad mkhyen/ /shin tu legs byas gzugs brnyan ni/ /mchod pas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol/ /'dir ni gzugs dang lhan cig tu/ /'gro ba'i don du bzhugs nas kyang / /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /mchog rnams legs par stsal du gsol/ /zhes dang / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sing ha nā da sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes pas mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs/ /bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod/ /bde bar gshegs so bcom ldan 'das/ /tshur gshegs 'dir ni bzhugs su gsol/ /bdag la mchod yon bzhes nas kyang / /'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol/ /sogs mchod yon gyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ga ga na sa ma ya hūm̐ swāhās/ mchod yod phul/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol/ /khrus gsol ba'i stangs ka byed cing / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes pas khrus gsol/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir/ /nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni/ /ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na/ /de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol/ /pad+ma'i phyag rgya dang / oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya satwaṃ/ zhes pas gdan 'bul la/ oṃ āḥhrīḥsing ha nā da sa pa ri wa ra ar+ghṃ nas/ shap+ta'i bar phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ slar yang thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shap+ta'i bar gyis mchod la/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ sarba ta thā ga ta/

zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing / bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las rje btsun seng ge sgra la 'od dpag med dang / rigs gzhan rnams la rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbur brgyan/ thab kyi gtso bo bla ma dang tha mi dad pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor te bzhugs par gyur/ zhes dang / snying po lan gsum byon zan gong me lha bzhin la/ ba ha nā ya/ bdag dang sems can gzhan sogs spel tshig gong bzhin sbyar ba lan gsum phul/ mchod pa byin rlabs byas la/ thal mo sbyar te/ mchod yon phal cher mchod yon bla bre dang / /mchod yon bkod pa'i 'od zer rab rgyas shing / /mchod yon sna tshogs kun tu bsgrengs byas nas/ /bdag nyid chen po dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sing ha nā da sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes sogs so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ zhabs bsil༞ zhabs bsil༞ zhabs bsil༞ bdag nyid༞ oṃ sarba sogs nas/ pā d+yaṃ sogs/ 'don pa bsgyur la/ me tog༞ me tog༞ me tog༞ bdag nyid༞ puṣ+pe༞ bdug spos༞ bdug spos༞ bdug spos༞ bdag nyid༞ dhū paṃ༞ snang gsal༞ snang gsal༞ snang gsal/ bdag nyid༞ ā lo ke༞ dri mchog༞ dri mchog༞ dri mchog༞ bdag nyid༞ gan+dhe༞ zhal zas༞ zhal zas༞ zhal zas༞ bdag nyid༞ nai wi d+ye༞ rol mo༞ rol mo༞ rol mo༞ bdag nyid༞ shap+ta༞ dharmā ra ṇi tas rol mo sogs dbul lo/ /nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba bid pu ra pu ra/ su ra su ra/ a brta ya a brta ya ho/ zhes brjod cing / thal mo snying gar sbyar la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad la/ /'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /srid pa'i 'khor lo rgyun bcad de/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar shog /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sing ha nā da sa pa ri wā ra tsakra rat+na pu dzi te hūm̐/

zhes sogs so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams la/ /nor bu rin chen 'di phul bas/ /bkren zhing phongs pa rgyun bcad de/ /'byor pa phun sum tshogs par shog /gong bzhin thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ tsakra'i gnas su/ ma ṇi rat+na sogs sbyar la/ btsun mo rin chen 'di phul bas/ /ma rig mun pa rgyun bcad de/ /shes rab dbyings kyi don rtogs nas/ /thabs dang shes rab 'brel bar shog /wasti rat+na༞ blon po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /phyi nang gsang gsum theg gsum ldan/ /bsam yas bstan pa rab 'dzin cing / /yon tan thams cad ldan par shog /ma hā ta rat+na༞ glang po rin chen 'di phul bas/ /lta ngan rnams ni rab bsal nas/ /bla med theg par rab zhon te/ /thams cad mkhyen grong bgrod par shog /hasti rat+na༞ rta mchog rin chen 'di phul nas/ /srid pa'i gzeb las nges grol te/ /rdzu 'phrul mchog gi shugs thob nas/ /sangs rgyas zhing du 'gro bar shog /tu raṅga a shwa rat+na༞ dmag dpon rin chen 'di phul bas/ /nyon mongs dgra las rgyal gyur nas/ /phas kyi rgol ba tshar bcad de/ /snyems bral mchog ni thob par shog /khad+ga rat+na zhes dang / kha dog dbyibs legs yid 'ong rgyan phreng ldan/ /phyogs dus kun na gzugs mchog ci mchis pa/ /mos blos dkyil 'khor lha la bdag 'bul gyi/ /bzhes shig bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sing ha nā da sa pa ri wā ra ru pa kā ma gu na pū dzi te hūm̐/ de bzhin du so so'i phyag rgya bcas pas/ phyogs dus kun na zin dang ma zin pa'i/ /yon tan tshig mchog sgra snyan ci mchis rnams/ /mos blos༞ /bzhes shig༞ /gong bzhin thog mtha' 'dra ba las/ /rū pa'i gnas su/ shap+ta sogs sbyar la/ phyogs dus kun na tsan+dan sbrul snying dang / /a dkar nag sogs dbang po tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos༞ /bzhes shig༞ gan+dhe༞ phyogs dus kun na ro dang bcud ldan pa'i/ /lus sems brtas byed ro mchog ci mchis rnams/

/mos blos༞ /bzhes༞ /ra sa༞ phyogs dus kun na 'jam mnyen 'khrigs chags pa'i/ /reg bya'i khyad par lus sems tshim byed rnams/ /mos blos༞ /bzhes shig༞ /par+ṣe༞ zhes pas gos zung 'bul/ rdor dril 'dzin pas gdangs yod med gang rung dang bcas/ 'khor ba 'dzin rgyu chags bral zhing / /'gro ba'i don la chags pa yi/ /pad+ma dmar po'i gdan la bzhugs/ /seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jigs dang bag tsha mi mnga' ba/ /kun tu thogs med stobs brnyes pa/ /seng ge dkar po'i khri la bzhugs/ /seng ge sgra la༞ /thabs dang snying rje'i ngo bo nyid/ /yon tan thams cad rab rdzogs pa/ /zla ba rgyas pa'i gdan dang ldan/ /seng ge sgra༞ /nyon mongs pa dang shes bya yi/ /dri ma gnyis spangs sku mdog dkar/ /'od zer dpag med phyogs bcur spro/ /seng ge sgra la phyag༞ /dbu la ral pa'i thor gtsug can/ /'od dpag med pas rab tu mdzes/ /tshogs gnyis ma lus rdzogs pa po/ /seng ge sgra la༞ /spyan gsum thugs rje chen po yis/ /khams gsum dus gsum gzigs pa po/ /phyag gnyis thabs dang shes rab nyid/ /seng ge sgra la༞ /phyi rol pa rnams 'dul ba'i phyir/ /rgyan spangs mchod phyir thogs pa 'dzin/ /gangs ri ltar dkar drang srong tshul/ /seng ge sgra la༞ /dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad la/ /mnga' brnyes rol pa'i 'dug stangs kyis/ /sems can don bzhugs phyed krung mdzad/ /seng ge sgra la༞ /zag bcas nyes skyon ma gos pas/ /pad+ma las skyes pad+ma 'dzin/ /pad+ma'i rigs mchog pad+ma bsnam/ /seng ge sgra la༞ /'gro ba'i gnod pa sel mdzad pa/ /dri med me tog gis bkang ba'i/ /thod pa dkar po g.yon na 'dzin/ /seng ge sgra la༞ /shes rab ral gri ye shes 'bar/ /ma rig mun pa thams cad 'joms/ /gti mug la sogs rtsad nas gcod/ /seng ge sgra la༞ /tri shu la ni g.yas na 'dzin/ /sna tshogs don mdzad ljang gu ste/ /khams gsum nyes pas mi gos phyir/ /rtse gsum 'dzin la༞ /gdug pa can rnams rab 'dul zhing /

/chu bdag dam las mi 'da' phyir/ /brang 'gro dkar pos rab tu brgyan/ /klu rnams 'dul la༞ /ye shes chen po'i rang bzhin can/ /dbang bskur ba ni rab stsol zhing / /sku gsum byin rlabs thugs rje can/ /seng ge sgra la༞ /spros pa'i mtha' brgyad las grol zhing / /longs spyod rdzogs sku'i rnam par mdzes/ /sprul pa'i rigs lngas dbu la brgyan/ /sku gsum lhun grub khyed phyag 'tshal/ /shin tu dang ba'i yid kyis ni/ /tshig gi phreng bas khyed bstod pas/ /bdag sogs 'gro ba ma lus kun/ /khyed kyi go 'phang mchog thob shog /ces pas gtso bo la bstod/ rigs lnga la/ snang stong rdo rje nam mkha'i dbyings/ /chos dbyings ye shes rdo rje'i sku/ /byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya can/ /phyag 'tshal rnam par snang mdzad la/ /gzung 'dzin rdo rje brtan pa'i sa/ /me long ye shes༞ /bdud 'dul chen po'i༞ /phyag 'tshal mi bskyod rdo rje la/ /rin chen rdo rje 'bar ba'i me/ /mnyam nyid ye shes༞ /mchog sbyin chen po'i༞ /phyag 'tshal rin chen 'byung ldan la/ /'dod chags rdo rje chos kyi chu/ /kun rtog ye shes༞ /ting 'dzin chen po'i༞ /phyag 'tshal snang ba mtha' yas la/ /phrag dog rdo rje bskyed pa'i rlung / /bya grub ye shes༞ /skyabs sbyin chen po'i༞ /phyag 'tshal don yod grub pa la'o/ /zhes pas bstod do/ /yang mchod bstod bsdus pa byed par spro na/ mchod pa rnams kyi tshigs bcad rnams dor la sngags tsam gyis mchod cing / bstod pa ni gtso bo la/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyan ras kyis/ /sems can kun la gzigs mdzad pa/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces dang / rigs lnga la/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang / /gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal/ /thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i/ /rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes brjod/

de nas bsreg rdzas rnams kyi 'gor snying po gsum dang / bar du rdzas sngags so so bcu/ mthar rdzas sngags spel tshig dang bcas pa gcig ste bcu gcig res phul la/ sdig pa sbyang ba dang / sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba'i don du/ til mdun du bzhag la/ rang gi snying khar sdig pa'i sa bon kaṃ yig nag po zhig bsam ste/ de nas tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad 'dus par bsams la/ lte bar hūm̐ yig bsam pa las 'od zer 'phros pas sdig pa rnams ded de/ sna sgo nas kaṃ yig gi rnam pas 'thon la/ mdun gyi til la thim par bsam/ de'i steng du a yig dkar po zhig bsams la/ de las 'od zer byung nas til la thim pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur pa lha rnams la phul bar bsam zhing / 'bum phrag brgyad kyi dbang du btang ste/ 'bul tshan re la snying po stong phrag gnyis re bzlas pas cho ga re la khri tsho gnyis re/ khyon cho ga bzhi la khri tsho brgyad 'gro zhing bar gyi 'bul tshan dgu la 'bul sngags snying po 'ba' zhig dang rjes mar sngon ma bzhin/ de dag gi bar skabs rnams su 'bul tshan gyi yam shing rnams me rgyun mi chad pa'i phyir rim bzhin 'bul bar las thab tu dus gcig la mi 'bul ba phyag len yin/ de yang / zhu ba'i rdzas rnams zhal du ste/ /gong bu'i rdzas rnams phyag tu'o/ /yam shing 'bar ba'i 'od la 'bul/ /ku sha dur ba gtsug tor la'o/ /de ltar bsreg rdzas rnams phul ba'i mthar/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ bstod pa gang rigs kyis bstod/ 'das gtor la lha bskyed chog mi dgos pa ma gtogs/ bsangs sbyangs byin rlabs nas bzung 'bul tshul tshang ma gong bzhin/ cha gsum kun rig bzhin la/ yak+ṣas bsang ba thams cad oṃ āḥmṛ ta hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang bar bsgyur/ bgegs gtor gyi bden bdar la/ khyad par du yang rje btsun seng ge sgra rigs lnga'i tshogs pa can gyi bka' bden pa dang /

zhes dang / bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis bdag cag dam pa'i chos sgrub pa la bar du gcod pa'i 'byung po gdon bgegs kyi rigs zhes sogs so/ /bgegs gtor phyir dor grub pa dang / shes na nye reg gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar ram/ mi shes na kha chus bshal nas phyir dor la/ gshegs skyems byon zan ltar phul/ 'bul tshan rdzogs skabs ltar mchod bstod byas la/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can zhes pa nas/ lhag chad thams cad zhes pa'i bar gong bzhin la/ nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes dang / g.yas pa'i srin lag gis thab kyi thal ba nas blangs te/ oṃ ā hūm̐ zhes dang / dpral mgrin snying gar bkus/ yig brgya bzod gsol gshegs gsol rnams gong bzhin no/ /de nas mar blugs gzar gang thab kyi nang du blugs la/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la raṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam par gyur par bsams la/ sngar bzhin mchod bstod bya/ bsreg rdzas kyi lhag ma rdzas so so'i sngags kyis phul ba'i mthar/ sngar byon zan gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar/ mar dgang blugs gsum gshegs skyems su dbul/ slar yang mchod cing bstod la/ gtor ma bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur par bsams la/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa'i mthar/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas dbul/ me lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams/ /zhes sogs kyi mthar/ 'dod don zhus la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /zhes sogs kyis bzod par gsol/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don/ /sgrub kyin bzhud cig byin za khyod/ /ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te/ /bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs/ /oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ zhes brjod cing / dbyug gu gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du phyir bskyed la/

me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrungs te/ dge ba bsngo zhing / bkra shis rnams gong bzhin byas la/ bsnyen pa 'bum phrag brgyad cu'i sbyin sreg ni 'byor ldan rnams kyis bya ba las phal cher gyis mi 'grub bo/ /des na 'bum phrag brgyad dang dgu'i kha skong sbyin sreg ni nyin gsum la cho ga tshar bzhi ste/ tshugs grol gnyis la re re dang bar par gnyis yin zhing dgu'i bcu cha yang brgyad kyi rigs 'gre shes so/ /gong ltar sbyin sreg grub nas dngos grub kyi phyir me ma yal bar thal ba mi bsdu zhing / bsdu ba'i tshe'ang rang nyid kyis thog mar bsdu ba'am/ yang na yongs rdzogs rang nyid kyis bsdus te/ sems can gyi las sgrib sbyang ba'i bsam pas chu klung chen por dor/ zhes rje btsun seng ge sgra'i bsnyen thabs sbyin sreg dang bcas pa 'di ni/ ngor chen dpal ldan don grub kyis mdzad pa'i bsnyen thabs dang / 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi gdon grol gyi cho ga ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi mi 'khrugs pa'i zhi ba'i sbyin sreg rnams la brten nas/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos bskul ba po brtson 'grus 'od zer sogs don gnyer rnams la phan pa'i bsam pas shin tu dag par sbyar ba'o// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ 'jig rten dbang phyug seṅge sgra'i bsnyen thabs sbyin sreg dang bcas pa/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 3
